Senses.PreferredTarget: meet a patriarch, kill the patriarch
AlternateTargets: on meeting a patriarch, kill the patriarch
Senses.Explanation: Literally, "meet a patriarch, kill the patriarch" (逢祖殺祖). Linji's surviving record places it inside a five-member roster: "meet buddha, kill buddha; meet a patriarch, kill the patriarch; meet an arhat, kill the arhat; meet parents, kill parents; meet kin, kill kin" (逢佛殺佛、逢祖殺祖、逢羅漢殺羅漢、逢父母殺父母、逢親眷殺親眷). This is the Chan bend: the honored religious and familial titles become the grammatical objects of the same repeated verb, and later masters preserve, question, and redeploy that severe roster. A successor record explicitly asks why a good teacher would want to kill people after quoting the three religious members, without supplying a prose gloss. Later uses attach the phrase to a sharp sword, place it opposite "carry the infant and encourage the child" (提攜赤子，撫獎嬰兒) in a contrast about grandmotherly kindness, or quote it in a New Year's address before comments on lineage descent. The records use killing language literally in the formula but do not record bodily killings in these deployments; this entry adds no symbolic object behind the named roster.
Senses.Note: The exact shorter string has 57 hits in 47 allowlisted texts. It is almost always paired with 'meet buddha, kill buddha' and often extended with 'meet an arhat, kill the arhat.' Linji's fuller roster is primary; later uses include quotation, interrogation, sword language, verse, and explicit contrast with grandmotherly care.

Occurrences.Kwic: 向裏向外逢著便殺——逢佛殺佛、逢祖殺祖、逢羅漢殺羅漢、逢父母殺父母、逢親眷殺親眷——始得解脫。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: 鎮州臨濟慧照禪師語錄: complete-case exact-turn review identifies Linji Yixuan as the actor for this occurrence.

Occurrences.Kwic: 逢佛殺佛逢祖殺祖逢羅漢殺羅漢。既稱善知識。為什麼却要殺人去。且道是什麼道理。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Continuation of the Lamp Record (續傳燈錄), Dahui Zonggao biography. The immediately governing introduction says, 'therefore Master Linji said' (所以臨濟和尚道); Linji Yixuan is the exact quoted speaker of 'meeting a buddha, kill the buddha; meeting a patriarch, kill the patriarch; meeting an arhat, kill the arhat.' Dahui Zonggao then asks why a good teacher would want to kill people and what the principle is.

Occurrences.Kwic: 逢佛殺佛、逢祖殺祖、逢羅漢殺羅漢。真淨老人自謂臨濟正傳黃龍的子，七出八沒，得大自由。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Record of the Ancestral Guidelines (列祖提綱錄): the target New Year's Eve small address remains in the unlabeled continuation of Gulin Mao's explicitly headed sequence; Gulin Mao says to kill Buddha on meeting Buddha and kill an ancestor on meeting an ancestor before appraising Zhenjing and Zhaozhou.

Occurrences.Kwic: 或問：『為何二十五年前無老婆心？』但云：『逢佛殺佛，逢祖殺祖。』『二十五年後為何有老婆心？』但云：『提攜赤子，撫獎嬰兒。』
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Baiyu (百愚禪師語錄): in his Qinglong Monastery hall address, Baiyu Si contrasts having no grandmotherly kindness twenty-five years earlier with having it afterward, glossing the latter as supporting infants and encouraging children.

Occurrences.Kwic: 單提一把吹毛利劒。逢佛殺佛逢祖殺祖。直教一物不得當其前。一法莫能隨其後。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: 天目中峰廣錄: complete-case exact-turn review identifies Zhongfeng Mingben as the actor for this occurrence.
